$comment: Store listing fields that apify push never sends. Applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs after every deploy. Title, description and categories live in actor.json.
seoTitle: yt-dlp Link Extractor - Any Video URL to Direct Links
seoDescription: Paste any video URL and get direct stream and download links plus metadata. yt-dlp on 1000+ sites: YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, Twitch, SoundCloud. Bulk lists.
exampleRunInput$comment: The prefill. Until 2026-10-29 the live example was the template's { "helloWorld": 123 }, which the API tab code samples and the .md page AI agents read showed to every buyer.
defaultRunOptions$comment: 1 GB since 2026-10-29: the Deno runtime that solves YouTube's challenges peaks at about 280 MB, so a run peaked at 398-425 MB of the old 512 MB default (runs 8SK5ftTg94e6x8OOD, lBm5XZ8vWF2aNaBBZ). A heap cap broke the challenge solver, and JIT-less mode saved nothing. The start event stays one event at 1 GB, and Apify covers the first 5 s of compute.

pricing.$comment: Store discounts (owner's Gentle ladder, rolled out 2026-10-29 after holehe and social-analyzer): Free and Starter keep the flat price, Scale pays 10% less, Business and above 20% less; apify-actor-start stays flat. Aug-Oct paid revenue of this actor came almost all from Starter, and Apify bills our platform cost of Scale and Business runs lower only when discounts are on (compute $0.16 and $0.13 per CU instead of $0.20, https://docs.apify.com/actors/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md). The CI script applies first-time pricing and decreases; increases go through Console with 14 days' notice.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

url-processed.eventDescription: Charged once per input URL the actor attempts to resolve, whether or not a video is found. Covers the resolve attempt.

video-resolved.eventDescription: Charged per video successfully resolved to its direct links and metadata.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: Store discounts: Scale plans pay 10% less and Business and enterprise plans 20% less. Free and Starter prices are unchanged.
